review_candidates.title: Software Development Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain core software systems that power our electronic design automation solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain robust C/C++ applications in Linux environments with a focus on performance and scalability. Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver features. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex technical issues across the software stack. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in compute
eligibility_evidence: Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver features. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer engineering. Strong knowledge of C/C++ programming in a Linux development environment, with OOP proficiency and solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Proficient understanding of GUI concepts and strong knowledge of C++ GUI frameworks (wxWidgets, Qt), with good knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Perl, and/or Tcl.
